identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Accept intentional deletion deliverables during readiness validation

review_prompts: Does the implementation require an explicit typed deletion marker rather than accepting arbitrary missing files?
Does readiness prove base existence and candidate deletion for the claimed path?
Do ordinary validator deliverables still fail when missing?
Are #414, #268, #269, AWS, and unrelated lifecycle state untouched?
residual_risk: Review was bounded to the implementation source/test scope; lifecycle metadata and hosted CI publication checks remain separate typed publication evidence.
